comparison.objective: Position three microphone stands according to the relational 3:1 spacing rule.
comparison.physical_skill: Weighted-stand transport, bimanual handoff, upright placement, and relational spatial planning versus fine fastener access and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each stand within 6 cm of its singer and every pair satisfying the 3:1 rule versus two consecutive safe axial stops.
comparison.reason: This tests coupled geometric layout rather than adjustment and locking of a mechanism. The body gives its key thresholds; no spec versions are available.
